description:

title: Applications Engineer, GTM Systems
description:
HackerOne is a global leader in Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). The HackerOne Platform unites agentic AI solutions with the ingenuity of the world’s largest community of security researchers to continuously discover, validate, prioritize, and remediate exposures across code, cloud, and AI systems. Through solutions like bug bounty, vulnerability disclosure, agentic pentesting, AI red teaming, and code security, HackerOne delivers measurable, continuous reduction of cyber risk for enterprises. Industry leaders, including Anthropic, Crypto.com, General Motors, Goldman Sachs, Lufthansa, Uber, UK Ministry of Defence, and the U.S. Department of Defense, trust HackerOne to safeguard their digital ecosystems. HackerOne was recognized in Gartner’s Emerging Tech Impact Radar: AI Cybersecurity Ecosystem report for its leadership in AI Security Testing and has been named a Most Loved Workplace for Young Professionals (2024).

HackerOne is at a pivotal inflection point in the security industry. Offensive security is no longer optional – it is the standard for forward-thinking companies that want to build trust and resilience in a world where AI-driven innovation and adversaries are moving faster than ever. With the industry shifting, HackerOne stands apart: we combine the ingenuity of the largest security research community with a best-in-class AI-powered platform, trusted by the world’s top organizations.

**HackerOne Values**

HackerOne is dedicated to fostering a strong and inclusive culture. HackerOne is **Customer Obsessed** and prioritizes customer outcomes in our decisions and actions. We **Default to Disclosure** by operating with transparency and integrity, ensuring trust and accountability. Employees, researchers, customers, and partners **Win Together** by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability.

**Application Engineer, GTM Systems**
=====================================

### **Location: Pune, India**

### **Working model : In-office**

### **Working time : UK shift**

**Position Summary**
--------------------

As part of HackerOne's Go-to-Market Operations team , the Application Engineer, GTM Systems will help design, build, and support the systems that power how our Go-to-Market (GTM) teams operate. You'll focus on hands-on development and integration across our Salesforce ecosystem and connected applications, enabling our Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to work more efficiently.

In this role, you'll apply an AI-Native mindset to automate workflows and simplify complexity in our revenue processes. You will collaborate with system owners and stakeholders across RevOps, Finance, and Marketing to deliver reliable solutions that keep our GTM engine running. Your day-to-day work centers on building, configuring, troubleshooting, and improving the systems our teams depend on.

As we open our new office in Pune, India, we're excited to welcome team members who value in-person connection, collaboration, and shared purpose. All roles in Pune are hybrid by design; remote options are not available. As a fully integrated part of HackerOne's global team, the Pune office will play a meaningful role in advancing our culture and mission. At HackerOne, we Win Together, and our Pune team will help lead the way by shaping a dynamic, in-person culture rooted in purpose and partnership.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

Success in this role will be achieved by delivering on the responsibilities below, aligned with HackerOne's Talent Principles — AI-Native, Change Agility, Data-Driven Decision Making, and First Principles Problem Solving:

* **Develop and maintain Salesforce applications –** Configure and support Salesforce Sales Cloud, Salesforce CPQ, and related GTM applications. Execute technical builds that solve defined business problems and maintain system reliability and data integrity.
* **Build and support integrations –** Develop integrations across systems like Luminance, Slack, Marketo, 6sense, and data enrichment tools using APIs and automation platforms such as Workato. Troubleshoot integration issues and resolve data flow problems with minimal escalation.
* **Identify and implement automation opportunities –** Work with GTM and business stakeholders to find ways to reduce manual work and improve accuracy through process automation and AI-enabled insights. Stay current on relevant Salesforce, automation, and AI trends, and share wins and learnings with peers.
* **Manage system changes with stability in mind –** Adapt to changing business priorities while maintaining system stability and data integrity. Communicate blockers early and escalate only highly complex or ambiguous issues.
* **Troubleshoot and document solutions –** Perform root-cause analysis on system issues, create documentation and playbooks for sustainable support, and help peers understand how to avoid or resolve common problems.
* **Collaborate on requirements and delivery –** Work with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, translate them into technical designs, and deliver solutions within defined scope and timelines.
* **Support testing, deployment, and release cycles –** Participate in testing validation, manage deployments, and ensure changes are properly documented and communicated to stakeholders.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* 3+ years of experience in Salesforce or GTM systems engineering, administration, or development roles.
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Salesforce CPQ, and platform automation (Flows, Apex, SOQL, Workato, or equivalent).
* Experience building and maintaining GTM system integrations across tools such as Luminance, Slack, Marketo, 6sense, or data enrichment platforms.
* Strong understanding of data models and APIs in the context of sales, marketing, and customer success processes.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Salesforce Administrator or Platform Developer certification(s).
* Experience with workflow automation tools that improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Familiarity with modern data visualization or analytics tools (e.g., Looker).
* Exposure to REST APIs, middleware, or integration frameworks such as Workato or Fivetran.

### **Compensation Band :**

INR 2,320,000 - 2,610,000 LPA

**Job Benefits:**
-----------------

* Health (medical, vision, dental), life, and disability insurance\*
* Equity stock options
* Retirement plans
* Paid public holidays and unlimited PTO
* Paid maternity and parental leave
* Leaves of absence (including caregiver leave and leave under CO's Healthy Families and Workplaces Act)
* Employee Assistance Program
* **Eligibility may differ by country**

We're committed to building a global team! For certain roles outside the United States, India, the U.K., and the Netherlands, we partner with Remote.com as our Employer of Record (EOR).

Visa/work permit sponsorship is not available.

*Employment at HackerOne is contingent on a background check.*

HackerOne is an Equal Opportunity Employer in the terms and conditions of employment for all employees and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, pregnancy, disability or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by international, federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all HackerOne employment practices, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. HackerOne makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

For US based roles only: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, all qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for the position.

title: Associate Director - Product Engineering
description:
**Company:**
------------

Marsh

**Description:**
----------------

We are seeking a talented individual to join our IT team at Marsh. This role will be based in Pune. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.

  
  

Our scaled Agile Delivery Methodology is transforming our IT teams in cohorts of Pods and Squads. If a Squad is defined as the smallest number of people required to deliver product functionality to market then a Pod is the smallest number of Squads required to deliver a complex product or collection of integrated products to market. Pods exist to create Products and services that deliver on business focused Missions. We in Product Delivery Engineering are on a mission: to transform the way our Mercer business and IT teams work together to unlock the benefits of rapid delivery of quality, secure software to market by empowered teams. We will do this by rolling out our Agile at Scale Delivery model. You will guide one or more Squads and will be responsible for their delivery of working software through production.

  
  

We are looking for a highly motivated, experienced Squad Leader with an enthusiasm for all aspects of product development who knows how to work with a team of highly skilled engineers. Our goal is to create an environment where continuous improvement of the development process is in focus and where everyone's common goal is to deliver outstanding software as fast as possible. You will be a proven expert in using the Agile / Scrum / Lean software development methodologies, a guardian of the delivery team's development processes and driven by delivering value. The Squad Lead will be an excellent communicator and facilitator, and not afraid to raise issues and drive change to remove impediments from the delivery team. You will have some familiarity with leading squads that incorporate AI solutions into their product(s).

  

**We will count on you to:**

  

* Run the software delivery for your Squad ensuring there are smooth and efficient processes for getting software through from requirements to working in production
* Identify and work to eliminate blockers
* Responsible for ensuring your Squad is motivated, collaborative, efficient and empowered
* e2e Delivery of working software for 1 or more products or solutions into production
* You will generally be responsible for 2 squads of between 5-9 people
* You will have an Enterprise mind-set able to foster collaboration, break down silos, identify and work to remove blockers
* You will be a recognized Agile Expert intimately familiar with the processes and practices required for successful and sustainable delivery. Our main delivery methodologies are Scrum and Kanban
* You will be proficient at creating highly performing teams and take a hands on approach where required
* Hands on experience of a range of squad-based roles is an advantage
* Solid understanding of Software Development, Architecture, Test Engineering and Security best practice in an Agile environment
* Pods support the full lifecycle of a product, and we operate on the philosophy that the work comes to the team. You will need to consider tech debt, obsolescence, security and modernization
* Ensure our Agile governance and ceremonies are in place and effective
* Plan product releases
* You will be familiar with acting as Scrum Master for teams developing or receiving AI solutions
* Our standard metrics are visible and actively being used to drive making choices
* Own the Continuous Improvement backlog for your squad. This is the key mechanism by which we deliver improvements for the following; time to market, efficiency and quality
* You will provide coaching and support to your squad ensuring that they operate well as a team and foster o culture of ownership and respect
* You may be asked to be a line manager to 1 or more other squad leads
* In addition to your day to day activities you will be assigned 1 or more workstreams leadership opportunities that will deliver cross-functional benefits to our organisation
  

**What you need to have:**

  

* Bachelors in a technology related discipline, or a combination of work experience, education and training equivalent to a five-year college in a technology related discipline.
* 12+ years of total experience
* Experience and track record of successful delivery in a regulated, complex, multi-product technological landscape. We also have significant security processes and legislative requirements to protect our customers and their data
* You will be expected to have a broad technical understanding to support your Agile credentials from software architecture through test, DevOps practices, security and operational run
* A metrics driven approach to delivery evaluation and drive out systems and processes that help define and report on the metrics we believe to be important
* Excellent stakeholder management skills. As we work to transform the Mercer IT and Business into a truly Agile organisation you will need to influence and coach senior executives, many of whom will be new to Agile
* Ideally familiarity with managing AI model developments into existing and new applications
* Pods and squads are distributed globally and utilise a mix of permanent and partner staff who work largely remotely so experience of working with and motivating distributed teams is vital
* You will be collaborative, Inquisitive and interested in technology and best practices
* Experience of a wide range of Technology roles is desirable, ideally with some form of development engineering background
* Rounded and holistic understanding of Agile Methodologies such as CSP, KMP & ICP-ACC Certifications or their equivalent
  

**What makes you stand out:**

  

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, comfortable interfacing with business users
* Good troubleshooting and technical skills
* Able to work independently
  

**Why join our team:**

  

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

  
Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, caste, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

title: Senior Engineer, VP
description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title: Senior Engineer**

**Corporate Title: Vice President**

**Location: Pune, India**

**Role Description**

* Corporate Banking is a technology centric business, with an increasing move to real-time processing, an increasing appetite from customers for integrated systems and access to supporting data. This means that technology is more important than ever for business.
* Deutsche Bank is one of the few banks with the scale and network to compete aggressively in this space, and the breadth of investment in this area is unmatched by our peers. Joining the team is a unique opportunity to help rebuild the core of some of our most mission critical processing systems from the ground-up.
* Our Corporate Bank Technology team is a global team of 3000 Engineers (and growing!) across 30 countries. The primary businesses that we support within Corporate Bank are Cash Management, Securities Services, Trade Finance and Trust & Agency Services. CB Technology supports these businesses through ‘vertical’ CIO aligned teams and by ‘horizontals’ such as Client Connectivity, Surveillance and Regulatory, Infrastructure, Architecture, Production, and Risk & Control.

Engineer is responsible for managing or performing work across multiple areas of the bank's overall IT Platform/Infrastructure including analysis, development, and administration. It may also involve taking functional oversight of engineering delivery for specific departments.  



**What we’ll offer you**

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy,

* Best in class leave policy.
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Planning and developing entire engineering solutions to accomplish business goals
* Building reliability and resiliency into solutions with appropriate testing and reviewing throughout the delivery lifecycle
* Ensuring maintainability and reusability of engineering solutions
* Ensuring solutions are well architected and can be integrated successfully into the end-to-end business process flow
* Reviewing engineering plans and quality to drive re-use and improve engineering capability
* Participating in industry forums to drive adoption of innovative technologies, tools and solutions in the Bank.
* Good team player over different geographies.
* Promote and coach healthy communication in and around the team.
* Strong communication with stakeholders
Take End to End responsibility from design to deployment through the environments all the way to production.  

**Your skills and experience**

* 15+ years of experience in the IT industry with hands-on in Java and SQL writing skills.
* Proficient in full stack development (Java, React, Angular 8+, Spring Boot etc)
* Deep knowledge and hands-on experience in Google Cloud, OpenShift, Docker and Kubernetes as well as exposure to a range of modern build tools, such as Maven, Jenkins
* Hands on development experience on Cloud based full stack application.
* Experience in python is desirable
* Experience with end-to-end design and delivery of solutions
* Experience in using AI tools
* Passionate about test driven Agile development
* Working knowledge of messaging (JMS, PubSub)
* Experience with Messaging and integration, Patterns, REST, SOA
* Strong hold on unit and integration testing
* Practices: Code Quality, Sonar, Veracode, Security, dev ops, Agile, CI & CD
* Hands-on experience with a Public Cloud provider. AWS, Azure or – ideally - Google Cloud.
* Familiarity with the components of modern cloud best practice:
  + Infrastructure as Code – With Terraform.
  + CI / CD using Jenkins, TeamCity, Github & Github Actions.
  + Kubernetes – ideally with Google Kubernetes Engine or RedHat OpenShift.
  + Packaging using Helm.
  + Experience with Anthos as Hybrid cloud setup.
  + Service Meshes – With either Anthos Service Mesh or, ideally, Consul Service Mesh.
  + Open-Source dependency management and CVE mitigation.
  + Observability using Google Cloud Operations or NewRelic.
  + GIT, JIRA, Artifactory and BitBucket
* Comprehensive understanding of Code Analyzers/Linters and security fundamentals:
  + Certificates, keys and their management
  + Secret best practices and management
  VeraCode. SonarQube, KtLint, Eslint etc.

  

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**

**How we’ll support you**

* Training and development to help you excel in your career.

* Coaching and support from experts in your team.

* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression.

A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs.  



**About us and our teams**

Please visit our company website for further information:

**https://www.db.com/company/company.html**

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Job Description

**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026.

  

**About Position:**

  

We are seeking a highly motivated Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to work closely with customers, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to identify, design, build, and deploy technology solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes. This role bridges customer needs and engineering execution by translating business challenges into scalable technical solutions. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering skills with customer-facing consulting capabilities and hands-on experience across cloud, AI, enterprise applications, APIs, and modern software platforms.

  

* **Role: Forward Deployed Engineer**
* **Location: All Persistent Locations**
* **Experience: 5 to 8 Years**
* **Job Type: Full-Time Employment**
  

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Partner directly with customers to understand business challenges, operational requirements, and desired business outcomes.
* Lead discovery workshops, requirement gathering sessions, and use case identification activities.
* Prioritize opportunities based on business value, technical feasibility, and return on investment.
* Design, build, and deploy proof-of-concepts, prototypes, and production-grade solutions.
* Develop scalable applications, APIs, and microservices using modern engineering practices.
* Build and integrate solutions across AI/ML platforms, Generative AI solutions, enterprise applications, cloud platforms, data platforms, and API ecosystems.
* Design and implement reusable frameworks, accelerators, and solution components.

At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.

Come break through with us.

  

Our Optical Communications segment has recently evolved from being a manufacturer of optical fiber and cable, hardware and equipment to being a comprehensive provider of industry-leading optical solutions across the broader communications industry.This segment is classified into two main product groupings – carrier network and enterprise network. The carrier network product group consists primarily of products and solutions for optical-based communications infrastructure for services such as video, data and voice communications. The enterprise network product group consists primarily of optical-based communication networks sold to businesses, governments and individuals for their own use.

**Function/Dept Purpose Statement:**

The Manufacturing Excellence Team (MET) serves as the custodian of process equipment reliability, maintenance excellence and continuous improvement. The team drives and implements equipment and process improvements, executes cost-reduction and reliability enhancement projects, supports operations through advanced troubleshooting, and monitors equipment and process performance to improve efficiency, uptime and overall plant effectiveness.

**Position Responsibilities:**

* Ensure safe working practices across all areas and implement & sustain PCPD requirements within process areas.
* Execute preventive, predictive, corrective and breakdown maintenance for electrical, controls systems and associated process equipment.
* Support teams in new equipment installation, technology transfer, safety improvements, process certification, cost reduction initiatives, documentation and training activities.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve complex technical issues and conduct root cause analysis (RCA) for equipment and process failures.
* Troubleshoot and maintain electrical, instrumentation, and control systems, including PLCs, SCADA, HMI, servo drives, VFDs, sensors, actuators and associated field devices including set-up and programming
* Diagnose and resolve equipment breakdowns related to automation systems, machine controls, communication networks and motion control systems to minimize downtime.
* Read and interpret electrical drawings, single-line diagrams, control schematics, and P&IDs.
* Maintain documentation related to statutory compliance, preventive maintenance, calibration, audits and other industrial standard requirements.
* Support the development and execution of plans to evaluate and implement improvements in existing technologies to enhance product quality, efficiency and reduce costs.
* Maintain a strong presence on the manufacturing floor to understand equipment and process performance, identify improvement opportunities, and lead DMAIC-based problem-solving initiatives to resolve chronic issues and enhance operational efficiency.
* Ensure electrical maintenance activities are carried out effectively to maximize equipment uptime, reliability and operational safety.
* Monitor equipment performance, analyze breakdown trends and implement preventive and predictive maintenance strategies to improve plant efficiency.

**Required Experience:**

* 5–7 years of experience in process equipment automation & maintenance within a manufacturing environment.
* Good exposure to industrial safety practices and compliance requirements.
* Proven ability to deliver results while effectively managing multiple tasks, priorities and operational issues.
* Significant hands-on experience on the manufacturing floor, with a strong understanding of machines and production equipment, and a track record of resolving electrical and control-related challenges in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
* Practical experience in troubleshooting and problem-solving on production lines using reputed PLC and servo drive software, with the ability to understand PLC logic, make code changes and implement program updates effectively.

**Required Knowledge:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, E&TC, Instrumentation or Control Engineering.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong data analysis skills, including control charts, Pareto analysis and pivot tables, with a sound analytical mindset.
* Preference will be given to candidates with relevant experience in Manufacturing 4.0 practices, including communication protocols such as OPC UA, EtherNet, Profibus and serial communication, as well as data transfer between control systems and plant servers.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively both as a collaborative team member and as a team leader.
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to develop proficiency in troubleshooting manufacturing equipment and analyzing manufacturing data.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
* Six Sigma Green Belt certification or experience in executing DMAIC projects will be preferred
* Familiar with AI

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

The Vulnerability Management Associate is a technical support role within the Vulnerability Management function, providing day-to-day platform administration, technical analysis, data validation, integration monitoring, testing, reporting, and support for enterprise Vulnerability Management technologies.

This role works closely with VM Engineers to provide day-to-day technical support across the Vulnerability Management technology ecosystem, with a focus on platform monitoring, troubleshooting, data quality, integration support, testing, reporting, and continuous improvement.

The role will support technologies including Qualys, Zafran Security, Wiz, Aqua Security, ServiceNow integrations, Policy Compliance, and Attack Surface Management capabilities.

**Principal** **Responsibilities/Requirements:**

  

* Provide day-to-day technical and platform support for Qualys, Zafran, Wiz, Aqua Security, and associated integrations.
* Monitor platform health, scanning activity, integrations, data feeds, API jobs, asset coverage, and data completeness.
* Perform initial troubleshooting of scanner, agent, authentication, API, integration, and data-ingestion issues and escalate complex engineering issues to VM Engineers.
* Support Qualys scanner and agent operations, including scan status, authentication results, failed scans, coverage, and troubleshooting.
* Support Qualys Policy Compliance activities, including policy/profile maintenance, control mapping, authentication issues, configuration assessments, and reporting.
* Support Wiz cloud-security and configuration-compliance capabilities, including validation of findings, coverage, data feeds, and integrations.
* Support Aqua and Kubernetes/container security platforms, including monitoring scanning coverage, image/registry/cluster data, integrations, and platform issues.
* Monitor Zafran data ingestion and enrichment from connected security technologies and identify missing, stale, or inconsistent data.
* Validate that vulnerability, asset, threat, exposure, and compensating-control information is flowing correctly into Zafran.
* Support and test Zafran AI agent use cases and automation opportunities identified by VM Engineering.
* Assist VM Engineers with testing and validation of Python/API automation and ServiceNow workflow changes.
* Monitor ServiceNow integrations to ensure vulnerability records, assignments, enrichment, status updates, and closure information are flowing correctly between systems.
* Investigate integration failures, incorrect assignments, missing enrichment, duplicate records, asset-matching issues, and other data-quality problems.
* Support Attack Surface Management by validating discovered assets, investigating ownership and attribution data, and ensuring ASM information flows appropriately into downstream VM platforms.
* Perform UAT/testing and validation for platform upgrades, configuration changes, integrations, new automation, and new security capabilities.
* Assist VM Engineers with POCs, implementations, platform migrations, and integration testing.
* Produce platform-support reporting covering scanner health, coverage, integration status, failed jobs, data quality, enrichment, and other engineering metrics.
* Maintain platform inventories, configurations, support documentation, knowledge articles, procedures, and runbooks.
* Work closely with VM Engineering to identify recurring support issues that should be permanently resolved through engineering or automation.
* Work with VM Operations when platform or data issues affect their remediation processes, while leaving vulnerability remediation ownership with the existing VM Operations team.
* Skill / ExperienceMinimum:· Experience supporting Vulnerability Management, Security Engineering, Security Platforms, or Cybersecurity Operations technologies.· Working knowledge of Qualys, Zafran, Wiz, Aqua Security, ServiceNow, ASM, or comparable technologies.· Understanding of vulnerability scanning, authenticated scanning, agents, asset inventory, and Policy Compliance/configuration assessment.· Familiarity with cloud, Kubernetes, containers, Linux, Windows, networking, and enterprise infrastructure.· Basic knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, scripting, and automation concepts; Python experience is preferred.· Ability to troubleshoot data feeds, integrations, authentication, scanning, coverage, and platform issues.· Understanding of ServiceNow/CMDB integrations and vulnerability workflows.· Strong analytical skills with the ability to investigate large datasets and identify coverage, enrichment, integration, and data-quality issues.· Ability to work closely with engineers and learn complex enterprise security technologies.· Experience supporting security technologies within a large enterprise environment preferred. **Preferred**:· 3-5 years of relevant experience· Any infosec certifications or related (desired, not a compulsion)

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  

**About Our Pune Office**

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

Job Description

**Job Description – Lead Workato Developer (LMS Integration & Automation)**

**Experience:** 6–8 Years

**Role:** Technical Lead – Integration & Automation

**Platform:** Workato

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Lead Workato Developer with 6–8 years of hands-on experience in Workato and enterprise integration development to lead the design, development, deployment, and maintenance of integration workflows for Harbinger's Learning Management System (LMS) platform.

The role requires strong expertise in the Workato platform, including recipe development, API integrations, workflow orchestration, data transformation, error handling, and automation governance. The ideal candidate should combine deep technical expertise with the ability to lead integration initiatives, guide developers, and ensure the reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability of enterprise automation solutions.

The candidate will work closely with architects, business analysts, project managers, backend developers, and other technical stakeholders to translate business and integration requirements into robust automation solutions. They should also be forward-thinking in their approach to AI-assisted development, intelligent automation, and AI orchestration, identifying opportunities to improve delivery efficiency and evolve integration capabilities.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Lead the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of Workato-based integrations and automation workflows for LMS platforms.
* Design, develop, and optimize complex Workato recipes using triggers, actions, conditional logic, data transformation, and reusable components.
* Build and manage integrations between LMS platforms and enterprise applications, databases, third-party systems, and custom APIs.
* Develop and maintain REST API integrations, webhooks, and event-driven workflows.
* Translate business requirements and technical specifications into scalable, secure, and maintainable integration solutions.
* Lead technical discussions, review solution designs, and establish best practices for Workato development.
* Implement robust error handling, retry mechanisms, logging, monitoring, and exception management to ensure reliable workflow execution.
* Troubleshoot integration failures, perform root cause analysis, and implement permanent corrective actions.
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across interconnected systems.
* Guide developers in writing efficient recipes and following coding, documentation, and integration standards.
* Collaborate with backend engineers, architects, DevOps engineers, and QA teams to ensure seamless integration across the platform.
* Manage integration releases, environment configurations, testing, and deployment activities.
* Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, eliminate manual interventions, and improve automation performance.
* Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted development tools and Workato AI capabilities where appropriate to improve productivity and automation outcomes.
* Take ownership of integration architecture, technical quality, and long-term maintainability.

  

**Core Technical Skills**

* Workato Platform Expertise

* 6–8 years of relevant experience, including at least 6 years of hands-on Workato development experience.
* Strong expertise in designing, developing, testing, and maintaining complex Workato recipes.
* Experience with:
* Recipe development, triggers, actions, and conditional logic.
* Recipe functions, callable recipes, and reusable automation components.
* Data mapping, transformation, filtering, and orchestration.
* Error handling, retries, exception management, and operational monitoring.
* Workato connectors, including standard and custom connectors.
* API platforms, webhooks, and event-based integrations.
* Understanding of Workato environments, connection management, deployment practices, and access controls.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex integration issues and optimize recipe performance.

* API & Enterprise Integration

* Strong understanding of REST APIs, HTTP methods, JSON, and XML.
* Hands-on experience integrating SaaS platforms, enterprise applications, databases, and custom-built systems.
* Knowledge of authentication and authorization mechanisms, including OAuth 2.0, API keys, and token-based authentication.
* Experience with pagination, rate limits, asynchronous processing, retries, and API error handling.
* Understanding of enterprise integration patterns, system interoperability, and data synchronization.
* Exposure to microservices and event-driven architecture is preferred.

* LMS Integration Expertise

* Experience integrating Learning Management Systems (LMS) with enterprise applications and third-party platforms.
* Understanding of LMS workflows such as:
* User provisioning and learner account synchronization.
* Course and learning content synchronization.
* Enrollment, completion, and progress tracking.
* Learning records and reporting data exchange.
* Integration with HRMS, CRM, identity management, and other enterprise systems.
* Ability to understand LMS data structures and design reliable, automated data exchange workflows.
* Familiarity with standards such as SCORM, xAPI, or LTI is an advantage, depending on the integration requirements.

* Programming & Data Handling

* Strong understanding of data structures, data transformation, and validation.
* Ability to read, understand, and troubleshoot API payloads and integration logic.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases for data validation and troubleshooting.
* Basic scripting knowledge in Python or JavaScript is preferred.
* Familiarity with regular expressions, data mapping, and JSON/XML processing.

* AI-Assisted Development & Automation

* Practical understanding of AI-assisted software development and automation practices.
* Ability to use AI tools to support workflow design, API analysis, documentation, troubleshooting, and test-case creation.
* Awareness of AI-driven workflow orchestration and intelligent automation capabilities.
* Ability to evaluate AI-generated solutions for correctness, security, reliability, and maintainability.
* Willingness to explore emerging Workato AI capabilities and identify relevant applications within LMS integration workflows.

  

**Technical Leadership & Governance-** The candidate should demonstrate the ability to:

  

* Own integration solution design and make sound technical decisions.
* Conduct design and code reviews to ensure adherence to established standards.
* Define reusable patterns and best practices for Workato development.
* Mentor developers and support technical problem-solving across the team.
* Establish standards for recipe naming, documentation, error handling, monitoring, and deployment.
* Identify integration risks, dependencies, and scalability concerns early.
* Ensure appropriate security controls, credential management, and access governance.
* Track integration reliability and recommend improvements based on recurring issues and operational metrics.
* Leadership & Collaboration Expectations
* Work closely with Business Analysts, Architects, Project Managers, Backend Engineers, QA Engineers, and DevOps teams.
* Lead technical discussions and contribute to integration planning and estimation.
* Break down complex integration requirements into manageable technical tasks.
* Support sprint planning, technical reviews, testing, and release readiness.
* Communicate technical risks, dependencies, and recommendations clearly.
* Take ownership of integration deliverables from requirement analysis through deployment and ongoing maintenance.
* Promote knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and responsible adoption of AI-assisted development practices.
* Engineering Mindset
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* A proactive approach to identifying integration challenges and preventing recurring failures.
* Focus on building scalable, reliable, reusable, and maintainable automation solutions.
* Ability to balance delivery speed with quality, security, and long-term sustainability.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to work independently and guide other developers.
* Curiosity and willingness to explore new Workato capabilities, integration patterns, and AI-driven automation opportunities.

  

Workato certifications, such as relevant Automation Pro credentials.

Experience with enterprise SaaS integrations, including LMS, HRMS, CRM, or identity management systems.

Familiarity with CI/CD practices and version control for integration development.

Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or AWS.

Understanding of data security, privacy, and enterprise integration governance.

Exposure to AI agents, LLM-based workflows, or AI orchestration platforms.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on Workato technical leader with at least 6 years of Workato experience, capable of designing and managing complex enterprise integrations while guiding a development team. They understand that successful automation goes beyond connecting systems—it requires robust error handling, data integrity, security, scalability, and operational reliability.

They should be comfortable owning LMS integration workflows end-to-end, resolving complex technical challenges, establishing development standards, and identifying opportunities to leverage AI-assisted development and intelligent automation to improve delivery efficiency and platform capabilities.

description:
**Key responsibilities**

* Lead discovery to clarify scope, assumptions, constraints, dependencies, and NFRs.
* Define solution options and recommend an approach with clear trade-offs (cost, time, risk, complexity).
* Produce and maintain solution architecture across applications, integrations, data, and infrastructure.
* Ensure alignment to enterprise architecture principles, reference architectures, and technology standards.
* Embed security-by-design, privacy, and control requirements; support risk and governance approvals.
* Collaborate with engineers, product owners, and vendors to translate architecture into epics/stories and delivery increments.
* Provide architecture assurance during build (design reviews, pattern guidance, resolving technical blockers).
* Drive operational readiness: monitoring, logging, support model, DR/BCP, and go-live criteria.

**Key deliverables (typical)**

* **Solution Architecture Document (SAD)** and/or **High-Level Design (HLD)**
* **Integration design**: API contracts, interface specs, sequence diagrams, error handling patterns
* **Data design artefacts**: conceptual/logical data model, data flows, lineage, retention considerations
* **Non-functional requirements pack**: availability, performance, scalability, security, observability, resilience
* **Deployment architecture**: cloud/on-prem/hybrid topology, network zones, CI/CD approach, IaC outline
* **Security artefacts**: threat model, IAM approach, encryption/key management approach, security controls mapping
* **Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)** and **risk/issue/decision logs**
* **Operational readiness pack**: monitoring/alerting, runbooks, support handover, DR plan and test approach
* **Estimates and roadmap inputs**: high-level sizing, cost model, migration approach (if applicable)

**Key skills (selection criteria)**

**Architecture & design**

* End-to-end solution design across application, integration, data, and infrastructure layers
* Strong grasp of patterns: microservices, event-driven architecture, API-first, integration patterns
* Ability to define and validate NFRs and translate them into design choices **Cloud & platforms**
* Hands-on architecture experience with **AWS/Azure/GCP** (at least one)
* CI/CD concepts and environment strategy (dev/test/stage/prod), Infrastructure as Code

**Security & resilience**

* Threat modelling and risk-based decision-making
* Producing solution design documents and mandatory artefacts.
* API design (REST/gRPC), exposure to SaaS solutions, and AI governance are essential.
* Data modelling fundamentals, data quality and governance awareness **Delivery & stakeholder management**
* Strong communication: can explain complex designs to engineers and senior stakeholders
* Experience working in Agile delivery, influencing without authority, and managing cross-team dependencies
* Pragmatic decision-making: balancing ?right? architecture with delivery pace (?perfect is the enemy of shipped?)

**Experience (typical)**

* Proven experience delivering solution architecture for medium-to-large initiatives in complex environments
* Experience in regulated industries (e.g., financial services) is beneficial

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Arkose Labs is on a mission to create an online environment where all consumers are protected from spam and abuse. As a Fast Company 2025 Best Workplace for Innovators, we provide a proactive fraud deterrence platform, Arkose Titan, designed to neutralize modern attacks powered by Agentic AI and LLMs. By combining proprietary intelligence with dynamic friction, we undermine attacker ROI to protect global giants like Microsoft, Meta, and Roblox. Headquartered in San Mateo, CA, we maintain a global presence across APAC, Central and South America, and EMEA.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Platform Engineer to grow our team in Pune, India. This team is responsible for managing the availability and reliability of Arkose Labs production systems. This role requires deep expertise in container orchestration, multi-cloud environments, and modern DevOps practices to support our rapidly scaling applications.

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will be responsible for improving observability, scalability, reliability, and latency of Arkose's platform, working closely with application development teams to achieve these goals.

**What you will be doing:**

* Design, implement, and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure across AWS and Azure platforms
* Improve our reliability by identifying and addressing gaps in our architecture, services, and tooling that have the potential to cause outages
* Working on tooling, automation, and circuit breakers that help Arkose to adapt to changing attack patterns
* Establish GitOps workflows and deployment automation, and configure blue-green/canary deployments
* Improving our OpenTelemetry-based observability stack to include more signals that can be acted upon
* Architect and manage Kubernetes clusters for containerized application deployment
* Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning

**Must have:**

* 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Cloud Infrastructure
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production environments
* Strong experience with AWS
* Strong experience with high-volume and high-uptime services
* Experience implementing cluster monitoring, logging, and tracing
* Experience with at least one of: Golang, Python
* Deep experience managing production Kubernetes clusters (EKS, AKS)
* Knowledge of GitOps processes and GitHub Actions
* Strong skills implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform
* Experience with modern SaaS-based software stacks

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with ScyllaDB
* Experience with OpenTelemetry
* Experience with CDN providers
* Knowledge of service mesh technologies (Istio)
* Experience with ArgoCD
* Expertise with Claude code

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary + Equity
* Beautiful office space with many perks
* Robust benefits package
* Provident Fund
* Accident Insurance
* Hybrid office model with flexible working hours and work-from-home days to support personal well-being and mental health

title: AI Engineer - Sales and Marketing
description:
**Your role**
-------------

As a AI Engineer - Sales and Marketing, you are the hands-on builder who turns approved AI ideas into working solutions for Sales and Marketing – creating the AI agents, building the workflows and automations, and bringing in the right data so the tools are accurate, reliable and ready to use. You work under the AI Delivery Manager, who sets priorities and follows up, while you make the delivery actually happen. The role does not own the product roadmap or replace the Product Owner, and is governed through the councils, where the delivery need and business value are highest.

  

**You will:**

  

* Build and configure AI agents for Sales and Marketing – turning approved use cases into working Copilot agents, prompts and skills that are accurate, tested and ready for day-to-day use.
* Design and build the workflows, automations and integrations behind each solution – connecting systems such as CRM, quoting and pricing so tasks flow end to end without manual workarounds.
* Bring in and prepare the right data – identifying, connecting, cleaning and structuring the data sources each agent or workflow needs, and keeping that data current, governed and fit for purpose.
* Test, troubleshoot and refine delivered solutions – validating outputs, fixing issues and improving accuracy and reliability so each solution is stable and supportable before and after go-live.
* Work day to day under the AI Delivery Manager – taking on prioritised tasks, keeping work items clear and up to date, flagging blockers early and delivering to agreed timelines and quality.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, business stakeholders, AI Platform Teams and Microsoft to clarify requirements, confirm technical feasibility and ensure solutions fit existing platforms, security and governance standards.
* Document what has been built and support adoption – producing clear technical documentation, demos and worked examples, and providing hands-on support so solutions are understood, trusted and maintainable.

**To succeed, you will need**
-----------------------------

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. We value diverse experiences and perspectives and are excited to see what you bring to the role.

You have a Master’s degree in computer science or equivalent by experience.

* Hands-on experience building AI or automation solutions – for example Copilot agents, chatbots, RPA or low-code and pro-code automations; integrating systems and APIs; and working with data (extraction, transformation, modelling and quality); ideally delivered in an Agile, sprint-based way alongside product and business teams.
  

**Knowledge Areas/Skills:**

* Practical, build-level knowledge of Microsoft 365, Copilot Studio, Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse), Teams and SharePoint
* The ability to design and build workflows, automations and integrations
* Data engineering fundamentals covering connecting, cleaning, structuring and governing data
* A good understanding of Sales, Marketing, CRM, quoting, pricing and lead management processes so solutions fit real business needs
* A disciplined approach to testing and troubleshooting
* The ability to explain technical work in simple business language to non technical stakeholders
  

**Technical Skills**

Strong understanding of AI/ML architectures including LLMs, data handling, embeddings, and agent-based systems and experience with Azure AI ecosystem (Azure OpenAI, API Management, monitoring, identity & access control)  



**Other Requirements:**

* Hands-on, delivery-oriented and detail-focused, comfortable owning the build from idea to working solution, and able to work independently under the AI Delivery Manager while collaborating across multiple teams in a dynamic international environment.

**In return, we offer**
-----------------------

* Culture of trust and accountability
* Lifelong learning and career growth
* Innovation powered by people
* Comprehensive compensation and benefits
* Health and well-being

**Job location**
----------------

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at our office in Pune.

**Contact information**

title: Senior Google SecOps Engineer
description:
Job Description

**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries.

  

**About Position:**

  

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Google SecOps Engineer to lead and deliver Google Security Operations (SecOps) implementation, migration, detection engineering, parser development, and SOAR automation initiatives. The ideal candidate must have hands-on experience with Google SecOps SIEM and SOAR capabilities, successful execution of end-to-end migration projects, and expertise in YARA-L detection engineering. This role is critical for driving SIEM/SOAR modernization programs, enhancing security monitoring capabilities, and supporting enterprise Security Operations Centers (SOC).

  

* **Role: Senior Google SecOps Engineer**
* **Location: All Persistent Locations**
* **Experience: Between 8 to 12 Years**
* **Job Type: Full Time Employment**
  

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Lead end-to-end migrations from legacy SIEM and SOAR platforms such as Splunk, QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel, ArcSight, LogRhythm, Exabeam, Cortex XSOAR, and Phantom to Google SecOps.
* Conduct discovery, assessment, planning, onboarding, implementation, testing, tuning, and migration validation activities.
* Design and implement scalable log ingestion architectures across cloud, network, endpoint, IAM, security, and application data sources.
* Develop custom parsers, parser extensions, UDM mappings, and telemetry normalization solutions.
* Design, develop, and optimize YARA-L detection rules to improve threat detection effectiveness.
* Convert detection content from SPL, KQL, AQL, Sigma, ArcSight rule formats, and other SIEM technologies into YARA-L.
* Build, migrate, and optimize SOAR playbooks, workflows, and security automation use cases.
* Integrate security tools and platforms using APIs for enrichment, triage, containment, remediation, and notifications.
* Support threat hunting, incident response investigations, forensic analysis, and SOC operations.
* Develop migration frameworks, onboarding standards, runbooks, validation plans, and operational documentation.
* Collaborate with security analysts, architects, engineers, and stakeholders to improve security monitoring capabilities.
* Perform detection tuning, alert optimization, and use-case enhancement activities.
* Assist organizations in strengthening threat detection, response, and security operations maturity.
  

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 8-12 years of experience in Cybersecurity, SIEM Engineering, SOAR Engineering, SOC Operations, Incident Response, or Detection Engineering.
* Minimum 1+ year of hands-on experience with Google SecOps implementations and operations.
* Proven experience delivering at least one full-cycle Google SecOps migration project.
* Strong expertise in Google SecOps SIEM and SOAR capabilities.
* Hands-on experience with log onboarding, parser development, parser extensions, UDM mapping, and telemetry normalization.
* Strong experience developing YARA-L detection content from scratch.
* Expertise in converting detection rules from Splunk SPL, Microsoft KQL, Sigma, QRadar AQL, ArcSight, and other SIEM technologies.
* Experience designing and implementing SOAR automation workflows and security orchestration use cases.
* Strong understanding of threat detection, threat hunting, SOC operations, and incident response processes.
* Experience integrating EDR, IAM, Cloud Security, Vulnerability Management, Email Security, and Security Operations platforms.
* Hands-on experience with REST APIs and third-party security tool integrations.
* Strong knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks, security monitoring practices, and enterprise security architecture.
* Experience performing security use-case development, alert tuning, and operational optimization.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management capabilities.
  

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents
  

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:**

  

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment.
  

**Let's unleash your full potential at Persistent - persistent.com/careers**

  

**"Persistent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind."**

title: AI Infra Engineer
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on AI Infrastructure Engineer to set up and operate open-source AI models on local hardware and develop Python-based automation for document and video data. The consultant will build reliable offline processing workflows that can be run independently by a nontechnical team member, with an emphasis on confidentiality, accuracy, and ease of use.

Key Responsibilities

· Install, configure, and troubleshoot open-source AI models and inference tools on local computers, without relying on cloud-based AI services.

· Develop Python scripts to extract and process text from PDFs, scanned documents, and screen recordings; integrate local OCR or transcription tools where needed.

· Build automated workflows for file inventory, document organization, duplicate detection, and structured output generation.

· Generate traceable processing outputs, descriptive filenames, metadata, and clear status/error reports.

· Protect original files and confidential data by using offline processing, separate output folders, and secure handling practices.

· Implement reliable error handling and restartable processing so interrupted or repeated runs do not lose work or create duplicate outputs.

· Document setup and operation clearly, and hand over easy-to-run scripts to nontechnical users.

Required Qualifications

· Strong practical Python programming and automation skills.

· Demonstrated experience running open-source AI models locally using tools such as Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp, or Hugging Face.

· Hands-on familiarity with models such as Llama, Qwen, Mistral, or DeepSeek.

· Experience extracting text from documents using PDF-processing and OCR tools such as PyMuPDF, Tesseract, or PaddleOCR.

· Understanding of offline data processing, file handling, logging, and confidentiality safeguards.

· Ability to work independently, troubleshoot technical issues, and explain the solution to nontechnical users.

· Based in Pune / Pimpri-Chinchwad, with availability for approximately 5–10 hours per week and occasional on-site work.

Nice to Have

· Experience with local audio/video transcription tools such as Whisper.

· Knowledge of Docker, NVIDIA GPUs, CUDA, and GPU-based model deployment.

· Exposure to RAG, LangChain, or LlamaIndex.

· Experience with large document archives, SHA-256 hashing, near-duplicate detection, JSON metadata, and restartable processing pipelines.

Join us at DIGIPATH AI and contribute your technical expertise to building reliable, practical AI solutions.

Pay: Up to ₹80,000.00 per year

title: Product Cost Engineer
description:
Req ID: 5221

Job Type: Hybrid

Location: Pune, MH, IN

  

**Main responsibilities and tasks:**

  

* Lead Value Engineering studies on cast, machined and forged compressor parts and commodities, in close cooperation with Engineering, Product Management and Category Managers (Procurement).
* Develop and maintain detailed bottom-up should-cost models for castings, forgings and machined parts – covering raw material, process routing, cycle times, Machine Hour Rates (MHR), labour, energy, tooling, yield/scrap, overheads and profit structures – to define the cost baseline and identify use cases.
* Build and maintain MHR databases, commodity cost modules and cost libraries with documented assumptions.
* Benchmark supplier quotations against internal should-cost models and support fact-based cost negotiations.
* Validate manufacturing assumptions with Engineering.
* Assess manufacturing feasibility and drive Design-to-Cost / Design-for-Manufacturing (DFM) improvements across casting, machining and forging (e.g. material substitution, near-net-shape, process routing, tolerance and tooling optimisation).
* Train buyers and engineers on cost drivers.
* Establish close relationships and a safe environment with project stakeholders to discuss insights, align on targets and agree savings opportunities.
* Produce the documents required to present should-costing study results, including a final report with cost evaluation, recommendations and study finalisation.
* Provide clarifications and assistance to decision makers during the decision-making process.
* Prepare project charter, project closure, regular reports, KPI tracking and planning for the assigned projects.
* Report on progress and roadblocks to project stakeholders and the Value Engineering Global Manager.
* Attend follow-up sessions with Management when required.
* Support process implementation and interface definition across the Systems Division of Burckhardt Compression.
* Drive forward the Value Engineering and should-costing process with suppliers and 3rd parties.

  

**Education, Experience and Languages:**

  

* Graduation / Post-Graduation in Mechanical Engineering or similar.
* Atleast 8 years' experience in manufacturing engineering and/or value engineering, with in-depth hands-on knowledge of casting (sand/investment), machining and forging processes.
* Proven expertise in should-costing methodology and cost-estimation tools (e.g. Excel, CostData, aPriori, Facton, Teamcenter Product Cost Management or equivalent).
* Core technical competencies: cycle-time calculation, Machine Hour Rate (MHR) development, CAD drawing interpretation, GD&T and manufacturing tolerances, and data analytics.
* Solid knowledge of Value Analysis / Value Engineering methodology and international standards (e.g. API, ASME, ASTM); able to read technical drawings, GD&T and material specifications for cast, machined and forged parts.
* Basic know-how of Master Data and SAP transactions.
* MS Office and Power BI.
* AI tools and AI Agent creation
* Ability to travel up to 20% of work schedule.
* Language: local language and fluent English; basic technical vocabulary in both languages.

  

Burckhardt Compression creates leading compression solutions for a sustainable energy future and the long-term success of its customers. The Group is the only global manufacturer that covers a full range of reciprocating compressor technologies and services. Since 1844, its passionate, customer-oriented and solution-driven workforce has set the benchmark in the gas compression industry.

description:
Staff Engineer – AI in Embedded Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

Location: Pune, India

  
  

**About GF**
------------

GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power-efficient and high-performance solutions for high-growth markets. With global manufacturing operations across the U.S., Europe and Asia, GF is a trusted technology partner for customers around the world. GF's talented global team remains focused every day on security, longevity, and sustainability. For more information, visit www.gf.com.

  

**Introduction**
----------------

GlobalFoundries is seeking a highly motivated Staff Engineer to lead the adoption of Artificial Intelligence across the embedded software development lifecycle. This role combines deep expertise in embedded systems with practical experience applying Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI-powered automation to accelerate software development, validation, and product delivery.

The successful candidate will serve as a technical leader driving the integration of AI-enabled workflows across platform software, firmware, test, and validation teams. This position requires strong hands-on experience in embedded software development, AI/ML technologies, and engineering productivity tooling, enabling the transformation of how software is designed, implemented, tested, documented, and maintained.

  
  

**Your Job**
------------

* Define and drive the technical strategy for AI adoption across the embedded software development lifecycle, including requirements, design, coding, testing, validation, documentation, and release activities.
* Develop AI-powered solutions that generate embedded software components such as low-level drivers, hardware abstraction layers (HALs), BSP integrations, register-access layers, and validation utilities from specifications and hardware documentation.
* Design and deploy Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems utilizing source code, technical documentation, silicon specifications, issue-tracking systems, and historical validation data.
* Build and fine-tune Small Language Models (SLMs) and LLM-based solutions for embedded software generation, test automation, defect triage, and engineering productivity enhancement.
* Develop automated pipelines that convert requirements and design specifications into executable embedded test cases, validation frameworks, and simulation scripts.
* Create AI-based solutions for post-silicon validation, including log analysis, anomaly detection, failure clustering, regression triage, and root-cause assistance.
* Integrate AI-enabled tooling into engineering workflows, source control systems, code review processes, IDEs, CI/CD environments, and validation frameworks.
* Establish model evaluation methodologies and quality metrics focused on correctness, code quality, coverage improvements, build success rates, productivity gains, and developer adoption.
* Define governance, traceability, security, IP protection, and compliance controls for AI-generated software artifacts in safety-critical development environments.
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and AI enablement across software, architecture, validation, and platform engineering teams.
  

  

**Other Responsibilities**
--------------------------

* Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs.
* Support engineering excellence through collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous process improvements.
* Maintain compliance with company quality standards, development processes, and product security requirements.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum **4 to** **8 years** of industry experience in embedded software development, firmware engineering, platform software, or related fields.
* Strong proficiency in C/C++ and Python.
* Hands-on experience developing embedded software for microcontrollers, microprocessors, automotive systems, or embedded Linux platforms.
* Strong understanding of RTOS concepts including scheduling, interrupts, synchronization mechanisms, memory management, and low-level driver development.
* Experience with protocols and interfaces such as CAN, LIN, SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet, or related embedded communication technologies.
* Practical experience with AI/ML frameworks including PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience developing and deploying RAG architectures, vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and knowledge retrieval systems.
* Proven expertise in model fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA and QLoRA.
* Experience integrating AI solutions into software engineering workflows, developer tools, CI/CD pipelines, and automated validation environments.
* Knowledge of model serving, optimization, quantization, and deployment in on-premises environments.
* Experience with embedded testing, silicon bring-up, HIL validation, system debugging, and hardware/software integration.
* Ability to work effectively across distributed global engineering teams.
* Ability to travel up to 10% as required.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Master's or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
* Experience with RISC-V processor architectures, toolchains, and ecosystem development.
* Knowledge of AUTOSAR, safety-critical systems, and functional safety standards including ISO 26262.
* Experience developing IDE plugins, engineering productivity tools, or software developer platforms.
* Experience with MLOps infrastructure, GPU-based training and inference environments, and enterprise AI deployments.
* Exposure to static code analysis, compiler technologies, program analysis, or code intelligence platforms.
* Expertise in AI governance, security, model evaluation, traceability, and responsible AI practices.
* Experience publishing research, contributing to open-source projects, or providing technical thought leadership in AI-assisted engineering.
* Experience working with semiconductor product development, post-silicon validation, or firmware platform teams.
